name: CKEditor 5 CSV to Table
description: Import CSV files into CKEditor 5 and generate clean, editable HTML tables.
project_description: Adds a toolbar button to CKEditor 5 that lets content editors upload a .csv file and have it converted, entirely in the browser, into a standard editable CKEditor table. The first CSV row becomes the table heading row; remaining rows become body cells. Parsing and insertion are chunked (500 rows parsed per tick, 25 rows inserted per model change) with a progress overlay so large files up to 50MB do not freeze the editor. The button is gated behind the 'use csv importer' permission, surfaced to the client via drupalSettings. There is no server-side CSV parsing route, no configuration form, and no custom text-format filter: the module relies on CKEditor's model API and the text format's own HTML filtering for the stored markup. Best suited to editors who regularly paste tabular data (pricing tables, comparisons, schedules, reports) exported from spreadsheets and want it as a native, further-editable Drupal table rather than hand-written HTML.
